what: Vertical-stack budgets for biomes/ricochetpeaks (Ricochet Peaks Boreal Crater-Archipelago, rmwvsvyf1iqzg): 5 station HTML pages (< 2.0 MB each via ricochetpeaks.tex.js sidecar), max samplers <= 15, and estimated VRAM <= 380 MB.

ricochetpeaks.html.why: Station 1 (ringlake): Yuni-Gate central rebound island, annular moat-lake, shatter-cone tors & Yuni Gaudi-mosaic snow-shingle shrine with sidecar textures.

ricochetpeaks-notch.html.why: Station 2 (notch): Skippers Notch 180 m doublet breach, twin crater lakes, KCARVE eyrie & bandit timber abatis with sidecar textures.

ricochetpeaks-vents.html.why: Station 3 (vents): East Hearth 6 boiling fumaroles, silica sinter terraces, emerald hot lake & snowBare oasis ring with sidecar textures.

ricochetpeaks-glasssheet.html.why: Station 4 (glasssheet): Glass-Pan jet-black tagamite floor, bonsai melt-pines, blue nickel-heather & meteoric iron/nickel/gold nodes with sidecar textures.

ricochetpeaks-highbowl.html.why: Station 5 (highbowl): Old Rim +5,100 m ET Erebus steam-ice chimneys, warm steam-cave & frozen WATER.ice tarn with sidecar textures.

*.why: Shared ricochetpeaks.tex.js texture sidecar pack serving all five Ricochet Peaks station pages.
